title: closing-bible checklist (checklist.json)
description: PRD §4 'Expected-set reconciliation', precedence 1: a user-approved closing checklist or index. The lawyer's list of what the closing set must contain. When a checklist is supplied, its execution_expected wins over inspection's, and its order is the bible's order.

ref.description: The checklist's own row reference, e.g. '3.2'. Copied into closing-index items[].checklist_ref.

parties.description: Optional. Copied into the index item where given.
